calendar.matters:
HEARING ON PETITIONER EMILY LUU'S PETITION FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-30-2026 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: The matter came on for Change of name of Petitioner Emily Luu.

Dept.505; Judge: Michelle Tong; Clerk: D. Carter; Proceedings recorded by "For the Record" commencing at 9:20am pausing at 9:22am resuming at 9:26am and concluding at 9:33am.

Petitioner Emily Luu appeared in with counsel Christopher Alexander Flocos both via zoom.

Petition for change of name and gender filed September 25, 2025.

Order to show cause filed September 25, 2025.

Notice of hearing filed December 11, 2025.

The Court addresses the petitioner and counsel.

The Petitioner provides testimony.

After reviewing the petition, hearing the testimony and there are no objections filed, The Court grants Petitioner's request for change of name.

Order Recognizing name change and for issuance of new certificates signed and filed this day.
